Subject: Post-call recap + proposed POC success criteria and readout

Hi Emily / Carlos -

Thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have a single source of truth: 

Quick recap:
- Goal: evaluate Redwood Inference to power clinical summarization and triage workflows in the Aurora intake pipeline.
- Scope for POC: 4-week trial across two intake queues (ER and Ambulatory) with ~1.5M tokens processed total.

Proposed POC success criteria (please confirm):
1) Latency: 95th percentile end-to-end < 700ms for 1k token requests during normal load.
2) Throughput: sustain 30 req/s for burst windows without > 5% error rate.
3) Quality: F1 >= 0.82 vs Aurora eval set on triage labeling (scoring file attached).
4) Cost: projected token cost under $0.0025/token for production equivalent traffic.

Proposed plan & timeline:
- Week 0 (this week): finalize SOW + security checklist; exchange test credentials.
- Weeks 1-4: POC run (integration + parallel evaluation).
- Week 5: Final readout + go/no-go decision from execs.

Owners / contacts:
- Marissa Cole (you can reach me for logistics & SLA questions) - marissa.cole@redwood.inference
- Marcus Lin (technical lead for on-call support) - marcus.lin@redwood.inference
- Emily / Carlos - Aurora product & procurement owners

Attachments: initial POC plan (attached as aurora-poc-plan.xlsx) and Redwood POC checklist (redwood-poc-checklist.pdf).

Ask: Please confirm the success criteria above and whether Aurora can commit to an executive readout week of 27-30 Jul (we'd aim for one 30-min exec readout during that week for a final decision). Also let us know your procurement timeline so we can surface the SOW to your legal/procurement team.

Thanks - looking forward to getting this scheduled.

-
Marissa Cole
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.inference

Hi Marissa - thanks for the clear recap. I reviewed with Carlos and we broadly agree with the success criteria - a few clarifications: 

- Latency: we want to make sure the 700ms p95 is measured end-to-end (Aurora app -> Redwood -> Aurora). Marcus, can you confirm instrumentation requirements so we can validate?
- Quality: we'll provide the eval set; our internal expectation is F1 >= 0.82 but we may accept 0.80 if recall is strongly prioritized.
- Cost: procurement flagged that we need an estimated 4-week spend cap for internal approvals.

Procurement notes: procurement@aurorahealth.com will need a draft SOW and our vendor security questionnaire completed before issuing any PO. Our target: SOW + security answers by Fri 24 Jul.

Final readout: CFO and CTO will be present for the exec decision. We can commit to a readout during 27-30 Jul - prefer morning ET.

I'll loop in procurement after this thread. We also have one question on data retention: can Redwood guarantee logs retention only inside Aurora VPC for the POC? If so, we can accelerate approvals.

Emily
Director, Product - Aurora Health
emily.zhang@aurorahealth.com
